verdict.rationale: YYLO is a command-line orchestrator for coding agents, and buyers can fairly ask whether a developer tool offers an enterprise license, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions enterprise licensing, SSO, commercial support or pricing tiers; the docs cover only CLI workflows, Ledger, benchmarks and skills.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can license an enterprise deployment with SSO and commercial support for organization-wide rollout
